summary: Reads the current session state from the session object (obj+0x3FC4) reached by dereferencing this[0]. If the state is not 4, returns it unchanged. If it is 4, queries a delegated COM/interface object at obj+0x3FB8 for readiness; when that call returns 3 the state is transitioned to 3. Returns the resulting state in both paths. Called by fifteen session/multiplayer lifecycle functions.

operations.description: If the session state field (obj+0x3FC4) is not 4, return the current state without any transition.
Return the current session state unchanged from the non-4 guard path.
Dereference this[0] to reach the session object and load the delegated interface pointer stored at obj+0x3FB8.
Query the delegated interface at obj+0x3FB8 for readiness via SingleDelegationCall_a900.
When the delegated call returns 3, set the session state field (obj+0x3FC4) to 3, transitioning from 4 to 3.
Return the (possibly updated) session state field.

unresolved: The numeric state space is only partially evidenced: 4 is the gate value and 3 is the transition target; the meaning of other values (1, 2, 5+) is not in the packet.
The exact contract of the delegated interface at obj+0x3FB8 and what return value 3 signifies beyond 'ready' is not named.
The session object base (this[0]) type is not named; only the two offsets 0x3FB8 and 0x3FC4 are evidenced.
